method: A Power Query query of a PBIX written by BIcraft, loaded by Power BI Desktop's refresh (black box), read each name's function type through the public M library (#shared, Value.Type, Type.FunctionParameters, Type.FunctionRequiredParameters, Type.FunctionReturn, Type.IsNullable, Type.Is); the saved file's loaded table was read back with BIcraft.
